DEFENSIVE MATCHUP WEIGHTS - ONE-SIDED (2026-10-20): factor = 1 + w x MIN(0, f - 1), f = shrunk opp-allowed / league ratio ((n x ratio + 4) / (n + 4), n = games played). A tough defense lowers the number; a soft one never raises it. Walk-forward 2025 + 2026 W3-6 (nflverse): the symmetric version (tested 10/11) did not beat no-adjustment because soft defenses do not lift production; the one-sided version cut MAE for every stat and moved tough-matchup actual/projection from 0.69-0.94 to 0.81-1.02. See MASTER log 2026-10-20.
PRIOR-SEASON BLEND: k = pseudo-games of the player's 2025 per-game average added to his 2026 average (AUTO - Prior Season 2025); fit 2024, tested 2025 + 2026
Blend = (2026 avg x games + k x 2025 avg) / (games + k); last-4 columns use min(games, 4). Players without >=4 games in 2025 (rookies) are unchanged.
